title: CE5 night in Sedona with Greer's team and Demi Lovato: orbs, gold disc craft and an unseen blow
place_text: Sedona, Arizona (off-grid site off a trail)

tellings.quote: So, we're sitting there, we're seeing orbs, we're seeing, you know, discshaped craft appear in and out.

plain: On a night at an off-grid spot off a trail near Sedona, Arizona, Michael Herrera says he sat with a group trying to call down UFOs through meditation and signals, a practice its followers call CE5. The group was led by a man named Steven Greer's team and included the singer Demi Lovato and a woman named Paola Harris. Herrera, who was there, says they saw glowing orbs and disc-shaped craft appear and vanish, among them a gold disc, and that something unseen struck a blow.
